figurative_meaning_en: To sit steadily in one place or settle down calmly
example_sentences_in_bangla: আগে থিতু হও, তারপর যা বলার বলো।
শিশুটি খেলতে খেলতে থিতু হয়ে বসল।
example_sentences_in_english: Settle down first, then say what you have to say.
The child sat still after playing around.
note: This idiom emphasizes composure in everyday Bengali interactions.
